capabilities.description: WebDriver automation surface for the Phase 6 E2E harness only. Inlined here, not a standalone file under capabilities/ — Tauri validates every file in that directory against the currently-compiled plugin set at build time regardless of this allowlist (confirmed empirically: a standalone e2e-testing.json broke the plain `cargo check` with 'Permission wdio-webdriver:default not found' even though tauri.conf.json restricts capabilities to ["default"]). Inlining it here means it only exists at all when this overlay is explicitly merged via --config, which only the CI E2E build step does. owasp-tcasvs V2.1.3: production builds must exclude test utilities.
